definitions.explanation: A financial situation where income exceeds expenses or gains exceed losses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今期|こんき}→今期：29530_konki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黒字|くろじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}した→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: We achieved a profit this term.

examples.japanese: ⟦ようやく→漸く：00429_youyaku⟧{黒字|くろじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転|てん}じた→転じる：noentry⟧。
examples.english: We finally turned a profit / moved into the black.

examples.japanese: ⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧{黒字|くろじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。

notes:
{黒字|くろじ} literally means 'black letters', from the practice of recording profits in black ink.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒字|くろじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become profitable)
- {黒字|くろじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to make a profit)
- {黒字|くろじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転|てん}じる→転じる：noentry⟧ (to turn a profit)
- {黒字|くろじ}⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧ (profitable operations)
- ⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧{黒字|くろじ} (trade surplus)

CONTRAST:
- {黒字|くろじ} (surplus, in the black)
- ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧ (deficit, in the red)

NOTE:
{黒字|くろじ}⟦{倒産|とうさん}→倒産：03452_tousan⟧ (bankruptcy despite profitability) refers to companies that go bankrupt due to cash flow problems despite being profitable on paper.
